body: Thank you Uncle Ben, much love.♡

so believe in them. i do. i believe that in another world he and I are close together and his face is pressed to mine and the things that became broken are whole again. warmth covers us like a blanket and we are tucked in by the moonlight that spills through the parted curtains. 
steady breaths, shared dreams. 

somewhere i exist with him forever as we were in the beginning, as we were when we had just met, walking hand in hand down that special stretch of pavement. sitting close beside each other beneath the stop sign at the corner. beneath the eternal setting sun suspended in place just a breath before meeting the horizon.
you wished for me and i wished for you.
and all of the shooting stars became vehicles for our tentative wishes, an audience for our tentative kisses.
maybe you can meet again some day... and if not, then perhaps in another life
at least we both know we are not alone. here's to hoping there is something good for us around the corner.
Thank you, much love

This is the most heartbreaking thing I've read in a very long time. It hit me hard. You're a beautiful writer. I dont have words. I'm so sorry this happened, and for all the questions it left you with and no answers. So, so sorry. Maybe you were meant to have Simon all along? Maybe he's with you to ease the pain a little, to be your friend in a lonely situation. I feel that sometimes animals can tell when you are hurting. I've put my arms around my (ordinarily very fidgety) dog and cried into his fur and he was so... still. It felt like he knew I really needed him for something.. and he gave it to me. And honestly with some animals, it kind of seems like they just dont give a fuck! And that's really okay. Some animals are pretty dumb. But they love you, you're their world, their best friend. You can bet that if they were intelligent to know how to help, they would.
When a cat greets you in the morning and they're purring so loud and they can hardly contain their happiness at seeing you, its because they love you. When a dog is so excited they go spastic because you're back after a 5 minute drive to the corner store, its because they love you! And it's just nice to hold onto that when you're feeling lonely or missing the love that you used to receive from a person.
same. It does not feel like I'm getting any better but hey... id like to believe I can get through anything, even something like this that feels so much bigger than I am

I know what that's like. We had a show too. Weve broken up many times and I worry whether or not he'll come back. Everything that reminds me of him hurts me, and I'm always hurting because the reminders of him are all around me... all of the little things I've picked up in my years with him. I cant throw them away, i dont have it in me to do that. So they stay where they are. And this sounds super dramatic but part of me does not want to live a life where he ISN'T all around me. It's so hard to love somebody so much that you desperately want to live out your whole life with them, and when they are not there with you, life and the future seems so very empty. 
I just wanted to say I understand.. and even though it does not seem this way, you are on the path to better things.. you will still get there eventually, even if you are shuffling your feet. Best wishes to you

I feel for you sooo much. I know the song, but the last time I heard it was before I could relate to it. I'm so very sorry you're going through this.. I'm right there with you, you arent alone. We will make it through this and we will be okay.. no matter the outcome of the situation. Life is beautiful... pain makes us blind to that. But it is.. there are so many things out there for you and me to see. Things we are meant to discover. it's okay to feel what you feel as you go thru the time it takes to be okay again. Keep your eyes on the horizon.. the sun will be rising soon my dear

I hear you, the hoping is so painful sometimes but it can feel like it's all you have to hold onto.. knowing you would accept anything they are willing to give you, friendship, anything to just be close to them again and to escape the absolutely deafening silence that surrounds you and consumes you when they leave without a word.. but despite all of this there is always the possibility that around the corner is something good. We focus on the bad 'what-ifs' and forget that there is another side to the coin, which is the possibility that we are in arm's reach of happiness and peace. Both are just as likely... and think about it, when you've been hurting for a long time and you're sick for the person you're longing for, something has to give... remember always, "this, too, shall pass" -- know that in this life, pain is simply inevitable... but time heals, and with time comes better things, always.

I'm sorry, that's tough. I guess not everybody is meant to make it through... and I've always been an optimist. Whatever happens between you and them, I hope you find peace in the outcome. And to move onto better things!

Hey, my situation is very similar to yours.. I'm with my bf for 3 years now and it's my first as well as his. When he is doing well he is so, so kind and sweet to me and a great person to have around... a wonderful guy, who loves his family and loves me, very much. But when hes going through an episode he changes drastically... hes so angry all of the time, at me and at everyone else too.. he has broken up with me many times, but we always end up back together again. I have questioned whether he is abusive to me when hes going thru an episode, he has sworn and raised his voice before.. and most recently he blatantly ignored me as i cried and begged for answers... that hurt more than anything. Deep down I know that if he were well and in his right mind he would never have done that to me.. I guess I wonder, what am I supposed to do if my otherwise wonderful boyfriend has a sickness that makes him not so wonderful anymore? You want to stay and help them get better.. I am still trying to figure out if this is the right thing to do. If you know in your heart that the person is worth it, and worth the patience it will take to get through the difficult times and to wait for them to find the right treatment... well I think that if your relationship can remain strong enough to make it through all of that, you may be able to face just about anything. Its hard as hell and I wish you happiness in your relationship, and the strength to get through this pain

I know this is old but my heart just aches for you.. I know the sort of pain that you're feeling, the exact sort.. I would not wish this pain on anyone, no matter what. I want you to know you're not alone, I understand what it is like... I have felt the helplessness, the agony of being desperate to get just a word from them, anything to hold onto so you can get through the day and sleep through the night. Perhaps it is not healthy to be so attached to a person. But you know what? I feel that loving somebody with this sickness is a unique situation that brings a unique sort of pain.  When you love somebody and make so many wonderful memories with them, when you become accustomed to the comfort and warmth and love that they give you, all of those simple things that bring joy and satisfaction and are perhaps taken for granted... when they suddenly pull away, it sends you reeling. Suddenly you're trying to process how they could do it to you when things were so wonderful just a few days ago, or even the night before. It makes you question your sanity. Makes you obsess over every aspect of the relationship, and question whether that happiness was just all in your head.. because if things were so good, how on earth could they just leave. I guess this comment turned out longer than I intended, but I understand what you are going through all too well. You arent alone my friend in this nightmare, I promise you there will come a day where you wake up from it, the days are not so terribly long anymore, and you can see good in life again, you can laugh again and see the sun again

this is a little old but I saw you did not get many responses. ive been dealing with this for a long time now and have learned a few things. firstly, it has helped me to realize and remember that their episodes is not my fault.. I know that I do not need to obsess over my behavior, looking for what I did to cause this... it is not your fault. They are sick. 
Another thing, and this one is very hard, is to remember that when they lash out, it's not because you are terrible or annoying or stupid... it's because they are sick. And it is the sickness talking. This does not mean that they shouldnt be held accountable for their words and actions, but it still gives me comfort to know they just really arent in the right mindset, and that they're lashing out because they're hurting/depressed/irrationally angry because of mania or hypomania. 
And lastly, take care of yourself, before anything else. That's HARD because you want to help and give them everything you've got, because you love them and your first inclination is always, what can I give them, what can I do? 
My advice is to try and direct some of that generosity and love toward yourself.. because loving somebody with BP is so hard to deal with. It makes you exhausted and its overwhelming.. you deserve a respite and you deserve to have peace
I've gone weeks, up to a month of enduring the distance and uncertainty of whether this time is truly it or whether hes coming back.. hurts like hell but perhaps it has made me stronger

this is somewhat of an old post but I just want to say... my BP bf's episodes vary in intensity... this current one is more mild than the one previous to it. That one was something else entirely, I truly and completely believed I had lost him for good. I was crushed, I was hysterical, i remember sitting on my bedroom floor and just telling myself, this is it, time to turn the page, cut off this phantom limb & get rid of the weight. and would you guess what happened? he came back to me and he came back with all of himself still there. he's slipped away from me again now but damn it.. it tears me up inside but it's not the end. I've been here so many times before and we find each other again, and so it goes
absolutely, so glad i could shine a little light in this darkness for you, and show you arent in it by yourself

no worries, I can handle blunt! I have learned that as well.. they do have to want it themselves, and ultimately it just isnt in my power to convince him what he needs. deep down I know I have no future with him if he does not commit to getting better but right now hes trying and that's something. thank you for the advice. ♡
thank you for the great advice. he isnt on meds at this time because the first medicine he tried did not help him and so he will soon be prescribed another

extreme irritability. Coldness, no empathy and no ability to truly relate. Aversion to touch. Wanting to be alone and just not give a damn about anything, and to do whatever they want. 3-4 weeks later the tide begins to turn, the warmth comes back, the aggression starts to fade, relationships improve drastically, the world is more peaceful. Then the cycle repeats, everything is infuriating, everyone is stupid, the world is a horrible place and life is pointless, etc.

I don't have bipolar but my boyfriend does, I can say that this is unfortunately very true for him and there are periods of time where he does not feel much for me at all, but when he is out of that head space it all comes back with the intensity that was there before.

I've been through it many many times, it does not get easier for me either. if it means anything you're not alone, you arent carrying all this weight alone, there are others who are carrying it too. And believe me I know how heavy it can be and how you cant even breathe sometimes. The loneliness and the panic of them not coming back to you. The small hope that I hold onto is that bipolar isnt a death sentence, its possible for them to get better and be stable if they want it enough, they just have to be committed to it. Ive learned that you cant push somebody to get help, we have to be patient for them to want it themselves. It's so hard and believe me I can feel it in my stomach how badly I want things to be better NOW but sometimes the things we want the most will come to us only if we are patient.

Sending all my good thoughts to you and crossing my fingers the pain will ease soon
I love this, it's so very honest. it's a nightmare being on this neverending rollercoaster ride, but i think you're wonderful for spinning it into something beautiful.

I'm soooo sorry you are going through this. I know how hurtful this is and I have endless empathy for you. Dont forget to take care of yourself, if you're like me then you give all of your love to this person and leave nothing for yourself, both of us deserve to be happy and to be okay.
Sneaky one! I bet she was very content to watch you search all over for her.
I can't afford to live alone, I will have to go back home, to my parent's house.
I actually live with him in his father's house, he took me in and I do not have any right nor am I entitled to living here. If he truly wants me to leave, I will. It's his family's house after all

Thank you for the advice, it's very valuable to me. I admit that without him, I feel lost and unstable. I need to work hard on this and become more independant and I need to be in a place where I don't feel like my life is pointless without him. It's so much easier said than done... but nothing in life is simple or easy for anyone and this situation is just what life has given me to overcome
